answer: A payout desk rejects any key that plants two markers on one surveyed line. The claimant locks 2.33 POA and is issued relic tag R-41, reserved to horizon stake HS-7, which must stay hollow of a second tag. Over 11 hours it collects four azimuth receipts from four different drones, each at least 78 minutes after the last, headings rotating by at least 9 degrees. Clerks admit the claim only if HS-7 still holds that single relic, the headings strictly rotate, and R-41 opens to the bond digest. A second tag, a reused drone, or a tighter gap slashes both bonds and keeps HS-7 sealed for four epochs.
